title: Asian stocks rally as traders pare Fed-hike bets ahead of US jobs data
summary: Asian benchmarks rose broadly on Friday: Hong Kong's Hang Seng climbed 2.2% to 25,765, Japan's Nikkei gained 1.3%, and Seoul/Singapore/Taipei all rose over 1%. The rally followed Fed Governor Waller's signals of a September rate hold; markets now await August U.S. non-farm payrolls due later today.
why: 美联储9月按兵不动预期进一步升温，推动港股恒指大涨2.2%至25765点，科技股领涨亚太；对持有港股仓位（sell put策略）形成阶段性支撑，非农数据今晚是下一关键催化剂

title: Fresh US-Iran strikes send oil surging past $90 WTI, $95 Brent; yields jump
summary: U.S. and Iranian forces exchanged fresh strikes, renewing fears of prolonged Strait of Hormuz disruption — through which over 20% of global oil trade flows. WTI settled above $90/bbl and Brent topped $95 for the first time since late July, marking oil's biggest weekly gain since July; Treasury yields spiked before pulling back.
why: 美伊战争再度升级是本轮最大地缘风险，油价飙升推高通胀预期，叠加美联储决策不确定性；亚太能源股受益，但整体市场波动率抬升对期权卖方需谨慎管理仓位

title: August 2026 jobs report today: only 53K payrolls forecast amid 'jobless summer'
summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the August jobs report Friday, September 4 at 8:30 AM ET; consensus forecasts call for just 53,000 new nonfarm payrolls after the prior two months showed a net loss of 3,000 jobs, potentially reinforcing the Fed's case to hold rates in September.
why: 弱非农数据将进一步压低美联储9月加息概率，利好风险资产和港股；若数据大幅低于预期，市场有望延续本周升势，期权卖方（sell put）策略短期处于有利环境

title: Costco August 2026 net sales $23.70B, up 9.9%; FY2026 full-year sales $297.3B
summary: Costco reported August 2026 net sales of $23.70 billion (+9.9% YoY), with comparable sales up 8.4% (U.S. +9.0%, Canada +4.0%, international +9.5%) and e-commerce surging 17.9%; FY2026 full-year net sales reached $297.3 billion (+10.2%), closing in on $300B.
why: 好市多销售数据持续超预期，会员消费韧性强；FY2026全年接近3000亿美元是重要里程碑，Q4季报定于9月24日，期权到期前有催化剂窗口值得关注

title: Xiaomi makes historic IFA 2026 debut: CyberOne humanoid on factory floors, in-house XRING AI chip, EV European push
summary: Xiaomi debuted at IFA 2026 in Berlin with its largest overseas booth (3,300 sqm, 380+ products) under the 'Human × Car × Home' theme, showcasing CyberOne humanoid robot deployed on EV assembly lines with 98% task success rate, the new XRING O3 3nm AI chip, and signed deals with German EV dealers targeting a 2027 European launch with €7.4B R&D commitment.
why: 小米IFA首秀是品牌出海战略破圈关键里程碑：汽车拟2027年入欧洲、机器人量产验证、自研芯片齐推；多重叙事共振有望推动1810.HK估值重估，IFA媒体曝光度达历史新高

title: Meituan's Keeta faces Brazil antitrust deepened probe after iFood complaint over predatory pricing
summary: Brazil's CADE ordered a deepened antitrust investigation into Meituan-backed Keeta after local rival iFood (Prosus) filed a formal complaint alleging predatory pricing — Keeta offers up to 250 reais per order and subsidizes up to 80% per transaction — and requested a preliminary injunction to halt below-cost operations.
why: 延续报道：CADE已命令展开更深层次审查，事件持续发酵。巴西监管若发出禁令可能实质阻碍Keeta扩张，美团3690.HK国际化叙事受压；持有美团仓位需持续跟踪巴西监管进展

title: Palantir wins $127M US Army TITAN AI ground-station contract; PLTR drops 6% on profit-taking
summary: The U.S. Army awarded Palantir a $127 million contract for eight TITAN AI-enabled tactical intelligence ground-system units; despite the contract win, PLTR fell ~6% on September 2 as investors booked profits after the stock reached ~144x forward earnings.
why: Palantir再获国防AI大单（TITAN是AI驱动战场情报系统），长期政府合同壁垒不变；但高估值引发获利回吐，IV可能随股价回调略降，sell put注意行权价选择
